'If I Die…': Actor Bala’s Ex-Wife Elizabeth Udayan's Video From Hospital Bed Goes Viral
Ex-partner Dr Elizabeth Udayan accuses actor Bala of abuse and threats in a hospital video, calling him responsible for her condition.
A storm of controversy has erupted around actor Bala following the release of a distressing video by his ex-partner, Dr Elizabeth Udayan. From her hospital bed, with a nasal tube visible, Elizabeth warned that Bala and his family “would be solely responsible if anything were to happen to her."
In the video, she questioned her chances for justice, asking in the caption, “Will I get justice before I die?" She shared, “I did not want to make a video in this condition. But I was unable to tolerate many things. I received many threatening videos and counter-cases, telling me to ‘protect your family’ and calling me a ‘money-sucking leech’. They are even claiming that the wedding never happened…" She challenged the denials by citing public moments, saying, “Then I don’t know why he introduced me as his wife in front of people, and did interviews and stage shows."

Elizabeth also said that she raised her concerns with the Chief Minister but saw no results. “If I die, that person is fully responsible. I had complained to the Chief Minister, stating that the police were not accepting my complaint… Many times, he and his lawyer failed to appear," she stated as the case moved through court.
Accusing Bala of misleading the court, she said, “In his counter-petition, he claims to have no money. He is a person with assets worth Rs 250 crore… It is written that we only had a doctor-patient relationship." She added, “I have spoken out about everything on social media… but I have not received justice. I am in the hospital right now. If there’s any doubt, the tests and statements can all be checked."
The allegations grow stronger and she said, “If I die, it is because of this one person (Bala). He cheated me, physically harassed me and defamed me in the media. Not just him, but his entire family… Everyone says that girls will get justice, but now I feel that justice is only for the rich and the powerful."
Bala responded to Mathrubhumi News, calling the accusations false and describing himself as the victim. He said, “I am living a happy life with my wife Kokila now. When my life is proceeding so happily, why should I hurt someone else? I am not here to justify myself… there’s a court order, as per which neither of us is supposed to comment on any of this. She has violated it."
He added, “Neither have I met her in person in recent times, nor called her over the phone… Earlier, I had said that this was a mass attack against me for money. I lost a lot in life. My only request is to leave me alone now. My family and I are being abused here."
